description_target.ambiguity_notes: The preserved raw_code is an archival radius-3 lookup implementation that happens to solve the four canonical pairs; target_code is the selected exact canonical semantic program. Execution parity of the archival source is required but it is not the teaching authority.
negative_constraints: Do not overwrite gray(5) or cyan(8) cells.
Do not continue red through a direct gray or a two-side-gray corner barrier.
Do not erase the yellow intermediate step immediately before a gray next diagonal cell.
Do not treat yellow paths as straight diagonals.
solution_steps: Locate the bounding box of the nine cyan cells.
Trace four red outward diagonals with direct-gray and two-side-gray stopping conditions.
Trace four clockwise-adjacent yellow alternating staircases with distinct start, intermediate, and next-diagonal gray behavior.
Recolor traced red cells with 2, then traced yellow cells with 4, preserving gray and cyan cells.
description_target.target_text: Find the single solid cyan(8) 3x3 square. From each square corner, draw a red(2) ray outward along the matching diagonal. A red ray stops before a gray(5) diagonal cell, and also stops before a diagonal cell when both inward orthogonal neighbor cells are gray. Also draw yellow(4) alternating staircase rays from the corners in the clockwise-adjacent outward diagonal directions. A gray start cell suppresses a yellow ray; a gray intermediate step stops the ray before that step; a gray next diagonal cell stops the ray after painting the preceding intermediate step. Preserve the cyan square, all gray cells, grid size, and all unrelated black cells.

racket_target.target_code:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g))
                (sq (find-color g 8))
                (r1 (apply min (map first sq)))
                (r2 (apply max (map first sq)))
                (c1 (apply min (map second sq)))
                (c2 (apply max (map second sq)))
                (grayset (find-color g 5))
                (isgray? (lambda (r c) (and (member (list r c) grayset) #t)))
                (inb? (lambda (r c) (and (>= r 0) (< r h) (>= c 0) (< c w))))
                (redray (lambda (cr cc dr dc)
                          (let loop
                               ((r (+ cr dr)) (c (+ cc dc)) (acc (list)))
                               (if (not (inb? r c))
                                   acc
                                   (if (isgray? r c)
                                       acc
                                       (if (and
                                             (isgray? r (- c dc))
                                             (isgray? (- r dr) c))
                                           acc
                                           (loop (+ r dr)
                                                 (+ c dc)
                                                 (cons (list r c) acc))))))))
                (corners (list (list r1 c1 -1 -1)
                               (list r1 c2 -1 1)
                               (list r2 c1 1 -1)
                               (list r2 c2 1 1)))
                (redcells (flatmap (lambda (cm)
                                     (redray (first cm)
                                             (second cm)
                                             (third cm)
                                             (fourth cm)))
                                   corners))
                (ycorners (list (list r1 c1 -1 1)
                                (list r1 c2 1 1)
                                (list r2 c2 1 -1)
                                (list r2 c1 -1 -1)))
                (yellowray (lambda (cr cc dr dc)
                             (let* ((sr (+ cr dr))
                                    (sc (+ cc dc)))
                               (if (or (not (inb? sr sc)) (isgray? sr sc))
                                   (list)
                                   (let ((startphase (if (< (* dr dc) 0) 0 1)))
                                     (let loop
                                          ((ar sr) (ac sc)
                                            (phase startphase)
                                            (acc (list (list sr sc))))
                                          (let* ((br (+ ar dr))
                                                 (bc (+ ac dc))
                                                 (pr (if (= phase 0) (+ ar dr) ar))
                                                 (pc (if (= phase 0) ac (+ ac dc))))
                                            (if (not (inb? br bc))
                                                acc
                                                (if (or
                                                      (not (inb? pr pc))
                                                      (isgray? pr pc))
                                                    acc
                                                    (let ((acc2 (cons (list pr pc) acc)))
                                                      (if (isgray? br bc)
                                                          acc2
                                                          (loop br
                                                                bc
                                                                (if (= phase 0) 1 0)
                                                                (cons (list br bc) acc2)))))))))))))
                (yellowcells (flatmap (lambda (cm)
                                        (yellowray (first cm)
                                                   (second cm)
                                                   (third cm)
                                                   (fourth cm)))
                                      ycorners))
                (g1 (recolor-cells g redcells 2)))
           (recolor-cells g1 yellowcells 4))))
